div.head: Af 1.6
div.ab: Gif he ut oðfleo ær þan fyrste, ⁊ hine man gefó, sy he XL nihta on carcerne, swa he ær sceolde.
Gif he út oðfleo ær þam fierste, ⁊ hine mon gefó, sie he feowertig nihta on carcerne, swa he ǽr sceolde.
Si aufugiat ante terminum et item capiatur, sit XL noctibus in carcere, sicut antea debuerat.
Gif he út oðfleo ær þam fierste, ⁊ hine mon gefó, sie he feowertig nihta on carcene, swa he ær sceolde.
If he escapes before the due time, and he is caught, let him be forty nights in prison, as he should have been before.
If he runs away before the [term of imprisonment is completed] and is recaptured, he shall remain in prison 40 days, as he ought to have done at first.
If he escapes before the end of the period, and he is caught, he is to be 40 days in prison, as he should have been before.
Wenn er hinausflieht vor [dem Ende] der Frist, und man ihn einfängt, sei er 40 Nächte im Kerker, so wie er vorher [schon] gesollt hätte.
If he escapes before [the end of] the term, and he is caught, let him be 40 nights in prison, just as he should have been before.
